name: AddAudioDirector (tail of cTSAppFW::AddCOMDirectorsHere): adds and starts the audio director unless the nosound switch is present
notes: Hooked (32 bytes). __cdecl, no arguments, EH frame (the switch-name string is destroyed if the test throws). Framework service slot 21 gives the command line, whose slot 9 IsSwitchPresent(cRZString 'nosound') decides; when absent the root director (GetCOMDirector) AddDirector(GetAudioDirector()), then slot 4 (OnStart) of the audio director with the root's framework object (vtable read before that object is fetched). Differential (AppCOMDirectors_AddAudioDirector, 11 command lines: plain, -nosound, /nosound, -NoSound, -nosoundx, -nosound:1, ...) with a real cRZCmdLine, a fake service/framework and the audio static built beforehand and given a recording vtable (slots 3, 4): the log, the root director, every static and the exit handlers registered are compared. Mutants killed: wrong switch text, inverted test, OnStart without the framework object, director not added, wrong framework slot. New status line (it had none).
